lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns and four horizontal rows, centered posterior to the gill slits in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical corridors of elevated luminance pixels crossing horizontal planes of high-intensity blobs, creating visible grid-like anchor points at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges extending across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a distinct light-to-shadow gradient transition along the vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A red filamentous trailing object is visible on the mid-lateral flank, and a white linear feature trails from the posterior base of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive cluster of small, high-reflectance fish (remoras) distributed along the ventral flank and pectoral fin boundary.
